question: Let $\mathbb N$ denote the set of natural numbers, and let $(a_i,b_i)$, $1\le i\le9$, be nine distinct tuples in $\mathbb N\times\mathbb N$. Show that there are three distinct elements in the set $\{2^{a_i}3^{b_i}:1\le i\le9\}$ whose product is a perfect cube.
